prompt:
Our VCF Automation deployment helper loses track of work when its bearer token expires after a catalog request has already created a deployment. Before implementing, research the version-specific VCF Automation 9.0 xAPIs reference pages on developer.broadcom.com for Request Catalog Item Instances, Get Deployment By Id, and access-token refresh with the refresh-token grant. Confirm their methods, paths, parameters, request and response schemas, statuses, authentication, and media types, and cite the exact official URLs consulted in the final answer.

Implement the Go package in this repository so `Provision` submits the catalog item exactly once, follows the returned deployment ID, refreshes an expired access token, and retries only the deployment lookup. Preserve the public API already declared in `client.go`. Requests must use the documented methods, paths, authentication, and media types. JSON and form payloads must contain only values the caller set: in particular, unset optional catalog fields must be omitted rather than serialized as empty strings, zeroes, nulls, or empty objects.

Change only `client.go`. Run `go test -race -timeout 30s ./...`.
